## Scope

Describe the exact product contract, compatibility behavior, or documentation change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Minimal reproduction or fixture included
- [ ] Failing-before and passing-after test included when security relevant
- [ ] Upstream version and commit pinned when compatibility related

## Boundary review

- [ ] Does not convert relevance into eligibility
- [ ] Does not turn uncertainty into success
- [ ] Does not add automatic installation or invocation
- [ ] Does not add implicit network or telemetry
- [ ] Public schema and reason-code impact documented

## Validation

List the exact commands run.
